Software Developer.summary: Designs, builds and maintains software applications.
Software Developer.typical_education: B.Tech / BE / BCA / B.Sc in Computer Science or equivalent (a self-taught path is also possible)

items: Learn one language well (Python, Java or C++)
Programming basics: variables, loops, functions, OOP
Git and GitHub basics
Data structures and algorithms
SQL and basic databases
REST APIs, debugging and testing
Build 3 small projects (command-line tool, REST API, simple web app)
Solve coding problems regularly on LeetCode or HackerRank
Contribute to an open-source repository
Publish projects on GitHub with clear READMEs
Prepare a one-page resume with project highlights
Practise coding and system-design interview questions

Frontend Developer.summary: Builds the visual, interactive part of websites and web apps.
Frontend Developer.typical_education: Any degree or diploma with strong web skills; B.Tech / BCA / B.Sc (CS) is common

items: HTML, CSS and responsive layouts
JavaScript fundamentals (ES6+)
Git and browser DevTools
A framework such as React (components, state, hooks)
TypeScript basics
Calling REST APIs and handling data
Clone 2-3 real websites pixel-perfectly
Build a full React app with API integration
Add accessibility and performance improvements
Deploy projects (Netlify / Vercel) and share live links
Create a personal portfolio website
Practise JavaScript and React interview questions

Backend Developer.summary: Builds the server-side logic, databases and APIs behind applications.
Backend Developer.typical_education: B.Tech / BE / BCA / B.Sc in Computer Science or equivalent

items: One backend language (Python, Java or Node.js)
HTTP, REST and JSON basics
Git and the Linux command line
SQL databases (PostgreSQL / MySQL) and schema design
A framework (Django, FastAPI, Spring Boot or Express)
Authentication, caching and Docker basics
Build a CRUD REST API with a database
Add authentication, tests and logging
Containerise and deploy the service
Document the API (OpenAPI / Swagger) in the repository
Showcase 2-3 deployed backend projects
Practise system-design and database interview questions

Mobile App Developer.summary: Creates apps for Android and iOS devices.
Mobile App Developer.typical_education: B.Tech / BE / BCA / B.Sc in Computer Science or equivalent

items: Programming basics in Kotlin, Swift, Dart or JavaScript
Mobile UI concepts: layouts, navigation, state
Git basics
Android (Kotlin) or Flutter / React Native
Calling REST APIs and local storage
Firebase for authentication and database
Build a to-do or notes app with local storage
Build an app that uses a live API (weather, news)
Test on real devices and fix performance issues
Publish an app to the Play Store (or share a TestFlight build)
Record a short demo video for each app
Prepare mobile interview topics: lifecycle, state management

Data Analyst.summary: Turns raw data into insights, reports and dashboards that guide decisions.
Data Analyst.typical_education: Any degree with maths / statistics exposure (B.Sc, B.Com, BBA, B.Tech); short courses are widely accepted

items: Statistics basics: mean, median, variance, distributions
Excel for cleaning, pivot tables and charts
SQL fundamentals (SELECT, JOIN, GROUP BY)
Python with Pandas and NumPy
Data cleaning and visualisation
A BI tool: Power BI or Tableau
Analyse a public dataset (Kaggle, data.gov.in) end to end
Build an interactive dashboard
Practise SQL and case-study questions
Publish analyses on GitHub or a Kaggle profile
Write a short insight summary for each project
Prepare for SQL tests and business-case interviews

Data Scientist.summary: Builds statistical and machine-learning models to find patterns and make predictions.
Data Scientist.typical_education: B.Tech / B.Sc / M.Sc / M.Tech in Computer Science, Statistics, Maths or a related field

items: Python programming
Statistics, probability and linear algebra basics
SQL and Pandas for data handling
Machine learning with Scikit-learn
Feature engineering and model evaluation
Data visualisation (Matplotlib / Seaborn)
Complete 2-3 Kaggle-style prediction projects
Build one end-to-end project: data, model, simple app
Learn deep-learning basics with TensorFlow or PyTorch
Write project notebooks that explain the business impact
Publish notebooks on GitHub or Kaggle
Prepare ML theory and statistics interview questions

ML Engineer.summary: Builds, deploys and maintains machine-learning systems in production.
ML Engineer.typical_education: B.Tech / BE / M.Tech / M.Sc in Computer Science, AI or a related field

items: Python and software-engineering basics (Git, testing)
Maths for ML: linear algebra, calculus, probability
SQL and data handling with Pandas
Machine learning and deep learning (Scikit-learn, PyTorch / TensorFlow)
Model serving with FastAPI or Flask
Docker and cloud basics
Train a model and deploy it as an API
Track experiments with MLflow
Build a simple data pipeline
Document projects with architecture diagrams
Publish deployed demos and code on GitHub
Prepare ML system-design and coding interviews

UI UX Designer.summary: Designs easy-to-use, attractive interfaces based on user research.
UI UX Designer.typical_education: Any degree or diploma; design, HCI or computer-science backgrounds are common, and a strong portfolio matters most

items: Design principles: layout, typography, colour theory
User-centred design and the design-thinking process
Figma basics
User research and personas
Wireframing and prototyping
Usability testing and design systems
Redesign an existing app or website as a case study
Design a complete mobile app flow
Run a usability test with 5 users and iterate
Build a portfolio with 3 case studies (problem, process, result)
Publish designs on Behance or a personal website
Prepare for design critiques and portfolio walkthroughs

Cyber Security Analyst.summary: Monitors systems, finds vulnerabilities and responds to security incidents.
Cyber Security Analyst.typical_education: B.Tech / BCA / B.Sc in Computer Science or IT; security certifications help

items: Networking basics: TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP
Linux command line
Security concepts: CIA triad, common attacks
Python scripting for security tasks
Vulnerability assessment and the OWASP Top 10
Wireshark, firewalls and SIEM basics
Practise on TryHackMe or Hack The Box labs
Set up a home lab and monitor its logs
Join beginner CTF competitions
Write up lab and CTF solutions as blog posts or GitHub notes
Work towards an entry-level certification (e.g. Security+)
Prepare incident-response and security scenario interviews

Cloud Engineer.summary: Designs, deploys and manages applications and infrastructure on cloud platforms.
Cloud Engineer.typical_education: B.Tech / BE / BCA / B.Sc in Computer Science or IT; cloud certifications help

items: Linux and networking basics
One scripting language (Python or Bash)
Core cloud concepts: compute, storage, networking
One cloud platform in depth (AWS, Azure or GCP)
Docker and Kubernetes basics
Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and CI/CD
Deploy a web app on the cloud with a CI/CD pipeline
Provision the whole setup with Terraform
Add monitoring, alerts and cost tracking
Earn an associate-level cloud certification
Document architectures with diagrams on GitHub
Prepare cloud architecture and troubleshooting questions

Business Analyst.summary: Connects business needs with technical teams using data and clear requirements.
Business Analyst.typical_education: BBA / B.Com / B.Tech / MBA or any degree with analytical skills

items: Business basics and the software development life cycle
Excel and basic SQL
Communication and documentation skills
Requirements gathering, user stories and process mapping
Power BI or Tableau for reporting
Agile / Scrum and JIRA
Write user stories and a requirements document for a sample project
Build a dashboard for a business case
Map an existing business process and suggest improvements
Prepare a case-study portfolio with documents and dashboards
Practise stakeholder and case-interview questions
Consider an entry-level BA certification (e.g. ECBA)

Digital Marketing Specialist.summary: Promotes products and brands online through content, search, social media and ads.
Digital Marketing Specialist.typical_education: Any degree (BBA, B.Com, BA, B.Tech); practical results matter more than the degree

items: Marketing basics: audience, funnel, branding
Content writing and copywriting basics
How search engines and social platforms work
SEO and content marketing
Social media and email marketing
Google Analytics and paid ads (Google / Meta Ads)
Run a small blog or social page and track its growth
Create a mini ad campaign (small budget or simulation)
Analyse the campaign results and write a report
Showcase campaign results in a simple portfolio
Earn free certifications (Google Analytics, HubSpot)
Prepare for marketing case and analytics interviews

Product Manager.summary: Decides what to build and why, guiding a product from idea to launch.
Product Manager.typical_education: Any degree; B.Tech / BBA / MBA are common routes; start with associate or APM roles

items: Product thinking: users, problems, value
How software is built (SDLC, Agile)
Communication and presentation skills
Market research and customer interviews
Writing user stories, product requirement documents and roadmaps
Data analysis basics (SQL / Excel) and prioritisation frameworks
Write a product teardown of a popular app
Create a product requirement document and roadmap for an idea
Lead a small project or club initiative as product owner
Publish teardowns and case studies
Practise product-sense and estimation interviews
Network with product managers and apply for APM / associate roles

Embedded Systems Engineer.summary: Writes the software that runs inside electronic devices and hardware products.
Embedded Systems Engineer.typical_education: B.Tech / BE / Diploma in Electronics, Electrical or Computer Engineering

items: C programming
Digital electronics and circuit basics
Computer architecture basics
Microcontrollers (Arduino, STM32, ESP32)
Communication protocols: UART, SPI, I2C
RTOS basics and debugging tools
Build sensor-based projects (temperature logger, line follower)
Write a driver for a peripheral
Build one IoT project with wireless connectivity
Document circuits and firmware on GitHub
Record demo videos of the hardware projects
Prepare C, electronics and embedded interview questions
